name: no_fan_flap_post_restart
observed_value: All managed fans held steady post v5.70.0 boot (01:29 CDT 2026-08-11). Jaya bedroom fan (fan.fanswitch_treat_wifi_jayabedroom) ran ON continuously 01:29→13:59 CDT (12.5h) — only a 12-second URA-authored toggle at 13:59 (vacancy + re-assert), not a boot flap. Living room fan (fan.towerfan_dreopilotmaxs_wifi_livingroom) transitioned OFF post-restart, then ran a normal 7-min automation cycle at 10:04 CDT. Study fan (fan.polyfan_dreo704s_wifi_studya) ran normal automation cycles (15–195 min durations). No rapid on/off cycling on any fan within the post-restart window.
expected: No rapid on/off cycles on any managed fan post-restart (delegation via FanPolicyOracle must be transparent).

tool_call_evidence.result_summary: fan.fanswitch_treat_wifi_jayabedroom: ON at 01:29:55, OFF at 13:59:01 (12.5h hold), ON at 13:59:13 (12s toggle, not boot flap). fan.towerfan_dreopilotmaxs_wifi_livingroom: OFF post-restart, ON at 10:04:41, OFF at 10:11:23 (7min normal cycle). fan.polyfan_dreo704s_wifi_studya: normal automation cycles, no rapid cycling.
